title: Customer totals report merges different customers and shows cents as dollars
body: Two bugs in the customer-totals report: (1) customers who happen to share a name get merged into one row — totals must be grouped by customer id, not name; (2) amounts render 100x too large — total_cents is shown as if it were already dollars. A row for customer 2 ('Bob', 5000 cents) should render as 'Bob: $50.00'.
bug: customer_totals groups by customer_name (merging namesakes) and render_report divides nothing — cents are printed as dollars.
